key_insight: Crystal structure prediction has evolved from global search to learned generation, but reviewed benchmarks show no universally dominant approach.
engineering_relevance: Reliable materials workflows should combine candidate generation with relaxation, ranking, and physical validation rather than rely on generation alone.
method: Survey CSP methods, software, reviews, and benchmarks from 1996 to October 2026.
Classify approaches from template construction and global search to ML-guided search and learned generation.
Separate representation, relaxation, ranking, and physical qualification.
evidence_signal: A 46-target benchmark showed the best template method leading top-1 recovery without statistically significant paired differences from several generative competitors; an experimental audit covered 68 materials, including 52 structurally confirmed cases.
watch_item: Within the reviewed evidence, no independently confirmed discovery used a deep generative model to predict the structure before experiment.
paper_title: Crystal Structure Prediction from Search to Learning: A 30-Year Expedition
